title: Inhalants
citation: General drug-recognition knowledge (confirm against DEA publications)
key_points: Examples: solvents, aerosols, glue, paint, gasoline, nitrous oxide, computer duster.
Signs: chemical odor on breath or clothing, paint or residue on face, hands or nose, slurred speech, dizziness, poor coordination, watery eyes, nausea.
Danger: sudden cardiac death can occur even on first use; suffocation is also a risk.
officer_notes: Possession or use to become intoxicated is covered by N.J.S.A. 2C:35-10.4.
